description: This C# source file defines the 'FormattedDocument' class within the 'MigraDoc.Rendering' namespace. The class represents a formatted, paginated document in the context of PDF or document rendering, handling page layout, headers and footers, page breaks, and rendering information collection. It is a core component for managing the layout and rendering process of documents in the MigraDoc PDF/PDFSharp ecosystem.

classes.name: FormattedDocument
classes.description: Represents a formatted, paginated document with headers, footers, and rendering information.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats the document, performing line and page breaks, preparing headers and footers.

methods.name: GetRenderInfos
methods.description: Returns rendering information for a specific page.

methods.name: GetFormattedHeader
methods.description: Returns the formatted header for a given page.

methods.name: GetFormattedFooter
methods.description: Returns the formatted footer for a given page.

methods.name: GetPageInfo
methods.description: Provides detailed information about a specific page.

methods.name: GetHeaderArea
methods.description: Calculates and returns the rectangle area for the header of a given section and page.

methods.name: GetFooterArea
methods.description: Calculates and returns the rectangle area for the footer of a given section and page.
